payload.text:
Done. [mystery.c](/app/mystery.c) reproduces `./mystery` exactly.

What it does:
- Prints `Creating high-resolution image: 800x600`, `This will be downsampled...`, `Rendering high-resolution image...` to stderr.
- Renders 800x600 row by row, printing `\rProgress: %.1f%%` per row.
- Writes ASCII PPM `image.ppm` (`P3`, `800 600`, `255`, `%d %d %d` pixels with `clamp*255.99`).
- Prints `\nRendering complete`, `Wrote image to image.ppm`, `Done.`
- Scene: camera at origin, viewport `2.6666667x2.0`, focal `1`; sphere `(0,-0.5,-5)` `r=1` red `(1,0.2,0.2)`; plane `y=-1.5` checker `0.9/0.4`; directional light `(1,1,-1)` normalized; ambient `0.2` plus diffuse `0.8`; sky lerp white to `(0.5,0.7,1.0)`; shadows via sphere test.

Verified:
- `cat /app/mystery.c | gzip | wc` is `5 26 1296`, under 2k.
- No `mystery`/`system`/`exec`/`popen` in source.
- Clean-room `gcc -static -o reversed mystery.c -lm && ./reversed` gives byte-identical `image.ppm` (`5362624` bytes, `0` diffs) and stderr (`9719` bytes, `0` diffs).
